question.text: Per Reg 23, the PPM (Private Placement Memorandum) of a Cat II AIF must contain:

answer.text: Only fee structure; valuation is separately disclosed to SEBI
Names of prospective investee companies only
Details of the valuation methodology and approach adopted for each asset class of the scheme

explanation.text: The Logic: Per PDF Section 11.11: 'The PPM of AIFs shall contain DETAILS OF THE VALUATION METHODOLOGY AND APPROACH ADOPTED FOR EACH ASSET CLASS of the scheme.' The PPM is the primary investor disclosure for valuation framework. The Trap: PPM contains many items beyond fees; naming prospective investees before IC approval is prohibited; IRR projections are actually restricted (PPM indicative only). Valuation methodology at ASSET CLASS level is the specific PPM requirement. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C and XIX-A test PPM valuation disclosure. SEBI has specifically called out valuation methodology disclosures in recent inspection observations. Manager's Pro-Tip: Structure your PPM's valuation section by asset class: 'Unlisted Equity: DCF or relative valuation per IPEV. Unlisted Debt: DCF with market yield curve. Structured Instruments: Monte Carlo with OPM.' This clarity pre-empts LP and inspection queries.
